correctness.rationale: The local product decomposition gives class weight w_A=S product_{i in A}(q_i-1) and adjacency A union B=[r]. Each class is a twin class, so at most one white vertex may remain in each. Since every class has size at least two, an inclusion-maximal white type T is uniquely visible from a blue vertex of complementary type T^c, which peels all white types. This proves the factored polynomial and Z=N-2^r. The quotient matrix is a row/column-complement permutation of the invertible disjointness Kronecker matrix, yielding a rank-2^r witness; M<=Z gives equality. The root multiset yields r, its minimum yields S, and normalized subset products recover q_i-1 with multiplicity, including factors equal to one.

value.rationale: The theorem treats all finite products of nonfield local rings at once and turns the full zero forcing polynomial into a complete graph invariant for this natural class. It gives every minimizer and exact maximum nullity/minimum rank, while the reconstruction theorem sharply separates recoverable residue-field data from the unrecoverable distribution of maximal-ideal sizes.
